About this item

  • MAGSAFE COMPATIBLE: This Belkin magnetic wireless charger pad is compatible with Apple iPhone 16, 15, 14, 13, 12, and certified MagSafe cases up to 3mm thick. Also compatible with Qi-enabled devices, including AirPods Pro, and supported Android devices.
  • FAST CHARGING: The MagSafe compatible wireless charger enables this iPhone charging station to fast charge up to 7.5W
  • POWERFUL MAGNETIC CONNECTION: The Belkin Wireless Charger uses MagSafe technology to ensure perfect alignment. Even with one hand the embedded magnetic system allows you to easily place your iPhone on the charging stand without any hassle
  • TRAVEL FRIENDLY DESIGN - Its slim, portable profile allows you to bring this magnetic iPhone charger anywhere. The 6ft long cable helps you access hard to reach hotel outlets, or use as a car charger and easily charge from the back seat
  • SAFE AND SECURE: Our powerful Magsafe compatible technology, and durable iPhone charging cable are designed for years of use. The wireless charging pad securely attaches to your iPhone, allowing youto keep using your phone without interrupting the charge

Product Description

Rethink how you charge with the Belkin MagSafe Wireless Charger Pad. This portable wireless charger pad is built with the power of MagSafe to quickly charge your iPhone 16, iPhone 15, iPhone 14, iPhone 13, or iPhone 12 series phone. When paired with a 20W wall charger, this MagSafe iPhone charger can quickly power-up an iPhone 14 from 0-50% in under 80 minutes, delivering up to 15W. It will even work with MagSafe compatible iPhone cases. When laid flat, it is also compatible with devices that support Qi wireless charging, so you can charge your AirPods (with wireless charging case), or Qi enabled Android or Samsung devices as well. Like all Belkin products, this iPhone charger is thoughtfully designed, and built to last. The charger pad has certified over-voltage protection to ensure safe but fast wireless charging for iPhone, and MagSafe technology ensures easy and accurate magnetic alignment. Available in three understated colors, and its slim, travel-ready design with built-in kickstand, this will quickly become your favorite way to charge at home, in the office, or on the go. Package Includes: Belkin MagSafe Wireless Charger Pad with 2M (6.6 foot) braided cable

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers say

    Customers find the wireless charger's 6-foot cord convenient and consider it a great half-price purchase. However, the charging speed receives mixed feedback, with some reporting quick iPhone 13 charging while others experience charging issues. Moreover, reliability is mixed, with some saying it works well while others report it stops working properly after a year. Additionally, the power supply is not included, and compatibility is problematic as it doesn't work with iPhone 6s and other accessories. The magnetic connection and heat generation also receive mixed reviews, with some finding the magnet too weak and others noting it gets hot easily.
